messages:
maria: Drafting launch checkpoints for tiered commitments. TL;DR: need clear gating for reserved pools (SLA), burst credits, autoscale fallback, and rollback triggers. Sharing my proposed checklist below — please react with :thumbsup: or comment.
aj: quick Q — are we treating prewarm credits as part of commit or add-on?
maria: add-on. Customers can buy prewarm packs; baseline commit covers reserved vGPU capacity + burst envelope.
kevin: propose 3-tier commit: dev (best-effort), standard (SLA 99.9 latency target), premium (dedicated pools + priority preemption protection). Also map burst credits as monthly envelopes that reset.
tara: agree on tiers. How do we handle autoscale? If pool hits 85% sustained for 5m, trigger add capacity; but for premium, fallback should avoid preempting premium tenants.
aj: can we encode that as policy? e.g.,
```
if usage_5m > 85%:
  try_autoscale()
  if no_capacity and tier != premium:
    spill_to_shared_pool()
  else:
    fallback_model_variant()
```
maria: yes that's the idea. Need precise SLOs and rollout metrics.
kevin: instrumentation checklist:
- per-tenant latency p50/p95/p99
- queued requests and rejection rates
- burst-credit burn rate (tokens/min)
- autoscale attempt counts and success/failure reasons
tara: add alerting: page when p99 > 2x baseline for 3+ mins or burst-credit burn rate exceeds 90% of envelope for 10m.
maria: Launch gating (must-have):
1) telemetry live in prod for 7d with no unresolved infra alerts
2) canary serving users >= 3 tenants (one high-throughput)
3) automated rollback policy validated by chaos test
4) pricing docs + customer-facing commit SLAs published
aj: Rollback triggers:
- widespread p99 increases + errors > 5% across canary tenants
- autoscale failures > 20% for 15m
- burst-credit accounting mismatches of >1% for 24h
kevin: we should also include soft-rollback: disable burst for affected pools, limit new sessions, keep existing sessions warm.
maria: scope tradeoffs for GA (what to cut if delayed):
- defer per-route token-level billing visibility (can be in console v2)
- defer prewarm add-on cross-region (initially single region)
- keep premium-tier preemption protection; but micro-pools prewarm may be beta
tara: customer asks (from ACME & BigBank):
- stricter eviction SLAs for premium
- per-tenant burst visibility + alert hooks
Assign: i'll take eviction SLA details (tara). aj owns autoscale policy implementation. kevin owns telemetry. maria will own rollout docs and pricing.
aj: timeline ask: proposal -> eng PR by EOW, canary start in 3w, GA in 8w if no blockers.
maria: sounds good. I'll update the doc and tag owners. Please add comments inline by EOD.
ops-bot: Deploy candidate created: deploy/1743219999-tiered-commitment-v1 to staging.
maria: thanks — will kick off a staging run tomorrow. :rocket:
